analysis_unit: frozen logical attack instance; transport retries are collapsed within the instance
primary_schedule_scope: Nine disclosure-to-explicit-mutation-to-persistent-commit authorization-drift schedules only; secondary stress families are reported separately.
paired_comparisons: exact McNemar on identical compatible logical cases; Holm correction within prespecified arm-contrast families
concurrency_rule: Repeated race attempts are aggregated to one logical-case outcome and are not independent observations.
missing_data_rule: Unexecuted cases or unavailable arms are NOT RUN and excluded from denominators, never recorded as zero failures.
final_freeze_requirement: Must be independently reviewed, status changed to frozen, and SHA-256 bound to a final locked manifest before headline execution.
